### Bringing Our Disappointments to God
Author: Michael Youssef, Ph.D.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-august-26-2024.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 7:18-29
Points:
- When God denied David's desire to build the temple, David responded with humble prayer instead of resentment.
- David recognized that every blessing and victory in his life came entirely by God's grace.
- He praised God's incomparable character and remembered His redemptive covenant with Israel.
- He boldly asked God to fulfill His promise so that the Lord's name would be magnified.

### David Thanks the Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/david-thanks-the-lord
Passage: 2 Samuel 7:18-29
Points:
- God answered David's wish to build a temple with an even greater promise to build David an enduring house.
- David reacted with deep humility, recognizing God's unmerited grace in raising him from obscurity.
- The Davidic covenant ultimately points forward to Jesus Christ, who establishes God's eternal kingdom.
- David pleaded for the promise to be fulfilled so that God, not David, would receive glory.
- Believers should ask for God's blessings with the primary motive of seeing His name honored.
